svg.text: Whether a world keeps a gas is a race between its gravity and the gas’s thermal speed.
Titan sits ABOVE the N₂ line only because it is so cold — at Earth’s exobase temperature it would
have lost its atmosphere. Temperature buys retention just as effectively as gravity does.
The lines are the retention criterion v_esc > 6 v_th, where v_th = √(2kT/m).
